records.modality: paired planning CT and first-treatment-day head-neck CBCT
records.labels_or_coordinates: five anatomical segmentation structures; final arrays 240x240x64 at 1x1x3 mm; no landmarks, transforms or correspondence table stated
records.recommended_use: paired CT-CBCT registration and segmentation stress-test candidate after file-level governance review
records.data_boundary: Radiotherapy head-neck data with no jaw-osteomyelitis, microscope, fiducial or navigation ground truth. Metadata verification does not establish file-level usability.

records.sample_count_detail: 240 training IOS scans and 100 hidden/test IOS scans stated by the official benchmark page
records.modality: upper/lower intraoral surface meshes referenced as OBJ plus JSON dental landmark coordinates
records.labels_or_coordinates: 3D coordinates with Mesial, Distal, Cusp, InnerPoint, OuterPoint and FacialPoint classes; coordinate unit and axis convention are not explicitly stated in the downloaded metadata
records.recommended_use: landmark JSON contract, point-pair parsing, rigid-registration noise simulation and dental surface correspondence research after acquiring the matching OBJ meshes
records.data_boundary: IOS dental surfaces do not contain CBCT, jaw bone, osteomyelitis, camera calibration or navigation tracking. The NoDerivatives clause prevents sharing adapted data; internal non-commercial analysis must retain attribution and the original license.

records.sample_count_status: full sequence count not asserted by the downloaded README
records.modality: endoscopic RGB, high-fidelity phantom OBJ/MTL, robot pose log, camera intrinsics and rendered depth/normal/optical-flow products
records.labels_or_coordinates: timestamped homogeneous robot poses, hand-eye calibration matrices, temporal offset, model transform and per-frame camera poses
records.recommended_use: L2 offline pose-log synchronization, transform-chain, reprojection, drift and frame-drop failure-injection validation
records.data_boundary: Colon phantom proxy with no jaw, CBCT or fluorescence-microscope geometry. The 1.515 GB sample was deliberately not downloaded.

records.license: CC BY 4.0 for dataset metadata; GitHub code carries MIT
records.sample_count_detail: 35 sub-datasets; README reports 42,700 ex-vivo and 21,887 synthetic frames
records.modality: ex-vivo and synthetic endoscopy video, timed 6DoF pose and high-precision 3D map ground truth
records.labels_or_coordinates: timed camera trajectories and 3D maps; exact coordinate convention requires dataset-level inspection
records.recommended_use: secondary L2 pose synchronization, trajectory continuity and tracking-loss validation
records.data_boundary: Gastrointestinal endoscopy proxy without jaw, CBCT, microscope metadata or surgical navigation accuracy ground truth.
